records.title: fix(followup): ignore inactive reminder scheduling
records.body:
Refs #372 #403.

Maximum Parallel safety fix from current production main `af928b5ae409fb9c352ac22076a1b04dee445919`.

## Problem
Future FollowUp reminder projection excluded trashed Tasks but still projected completed/archived Tasks, while the due-delivery boundary correctly excludes all inactive Tasks. That mismatch could wake the single Android scheduler for reminder work that can never be delivered.

## Scope
- make pending FollowUp reminder projection exclude completed, archived and trashed Tasks consistently
- add regression coverage for completed/archived/trashed future reminders
- preserve exact-now reminder semantics, deterministic ordering and Task-level reminder independence

## Safety
- exactly two existing projection/test files
- no model/store/storage-key/alarm/notification changes
- no force merge
- #429 must not merge until this fix is integrated or its head is synchronized with it

Keep Draft for exact-head Fast. Promote only after Fast and current-main sanity; require full Build/APK/Device before production merge.

- add one pure arbiter across existing automatic FollowUp schedules and independent FollowUp reminders
- choose exactly the nearest schedule for the existing single Android alarm foundation
- retry overdue undelivered reminders after the same safe minimum delay instead of losing them or creating an immediate loop
- skip reminder delivery identities already delivered
- keep automatic-delivery state semantics unchanged
- deterministically prefer existing automatic FollowUp on exact ties

## Safety
- exactly two new pure service/test files
- no Task/FollowUp model change
- no storage key, notification channel, AlarmManager call or platform side effect
- no second scheduler/alarm engine
- active-task filtering is enforced locally so inactive reminder work cannot win arbitration
- this lane can supersede the standalone reminder-only planner #429 once full-gate validated
